title: Security with Identical Inner Permutations
summary: The repeated-inner-permutation iterated Even–Mansour cipher is a practically appealing variant, but determining its security remains open.

formal_statement.body: Determine the security of the $t$-round iterated Even--Mansour cipher when the same inner permutation is used in every round, namely $P_1 = \cdots = P_t$. This practically appealing repeated-inner-permutation case remains an unresolved direction for research.

scope.domain: Security analysis of the iterated Even–Mansour block cipher with one inner permutation reused across all rounds.
parameters: P_1 through P_t: inner round permutations constrained to be identical
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine the security of the repeated-inner-permutation variant.

citations.label: An Asymptotically Tight Security Analysis of the Iterated Even-Mansour Cipher

progress.summary: The paper presents the case in which all inner permutations are identical as a practically appealing direction for research. Its security remains unresolved.
citation_labels: Rodolphe Lampe et al., An Asymptotically Tight Security Analysis of the Iterated Even-Mansour Cipher
